title: The Immigration Services Act
verified_how: fetched the Office of the King's Printer Publications Centre record for product 124069 through the site's own JSON API (/api/v1/products/124069): name 'The Immigration Services Act', Chapter 14 of the Statutes of Saskatchewan, 2024, effective 1 July 2024, 'Last update posted: 9 July 2024'
notes: Listed rather than recorded as a gap because Saskatchewan does legislate here: the register describes it as 'An Act respecting Immigration Services and Foreign Worker Recruitment', licensing foreign-worker recruiters and immigration consultants and underpinning the Saskatchewan Immigrant Nominee Program. The work permit and the immigration status themselves remain federal, under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, S.C. 2001, c. 27, and SOR/2002-227.
